items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Some news today that Neemias Queta is dealing with some sort of injury. Portugal removed him early in the fourth quarter of their win over Spain on Friday because he there was a "real risk" of injury, according to Portugal's head coach.

Unclear what the injury is, as the coach never stated it.

items.title: Neemias Queta helped lead Portugal to a big win over Spain today: 16 points, 9 rebounds, 2 steals.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Neemias Queta helped lead Portugal to a big win over Spain today: 16 points, 9 rebounds, 2 steals.

Aday Mara was strong for Spain with 12 points, 6 rebounds and 4 blocks.

Hugo Gonzalez had a rough game with just 3 points on 1-for-4 shooting (all from three).
